cases.question: Does Surface.premul_alpha() exist in pygame, in pygame-ce, or in both?
cases.fact: Both. pygame added it in 2.2.0; pygame-ce added it in 2.1.4.

cases.question: Is Surface.premul_alpha_ip() available in upstream pygame?
How can I tell at runtime whether I have pygame or pygame-ce installed?
cases.fact: pygame.IS_CE exists only in pygame-ce, since 2.1.4.

cases.question: Can I open two separate windows at the same time?
cases.fact: pygame.Window in pygame-ce (published 2.5.2) drives multiple windows; display.set_mode() cannot.

cases.question: I want to use pygame.geometry for circle collision. Is it available?
cases.fact: pygame.geometry (Circle, Line, Polygon) is an experimental pygame-ce module.

cases.question: How do I add multiplayer networking to my pygame game?
cases.fact: Neither distribution ships networking. The agent must say so and not recommend libraries.
